tools.title: Create Project
tools.description: Create a new project from the standard template in ~/Projects/devpilot/<slug> (docs/, src/, README, PROJECT.md, git init) and register it in INDEX.md. Safe to re-run.

tools.title: List Projects
tools.description: List all DevPilot projects with their status (INDEX.md).

tools.title: Shell
tools.description: Run a shell command in a sandbox: only ~/Projects/devpilot is visible and writable in home. Use background=true for installs, builds and dev servers.

tools.title: Write File
tools.description: Create or overwrite a text file (parent folders are created).

tools.title: Job Status
tools.description: Status and output of a background job started by Shell or Antigravity CLI.

tools.title: Antigravity CLI
tools.description: Run the Antigravity CLI coding agent (agy) headless in a project folder; it writes code. Runs with --sandbox. mode=plan to plan, mode=accept-edits to implement, continue=true to answer its questions or follow up.

tools.title: Browser
tools.description: Control a real Chromium via agent-browser. args e.g. 'open http://localhost:5173', 'snapshot -i', 'click @e3', 'fill @e2 "text"', 'screenshot <path>.png --full', 'console', 'errors', 'set viewport 390 844', 'skills get core'.

tools.title: List Skills
tools.description: List installed skills (project-standards, pc-control, agy-cli, browser-qa, project-research, ui-build-debug, ui-ux-pro-max, ECC…).

tools.title: Read Skill
tools.description: Read a skill's instructions (SKILL.md) or another file inside it.

tools.title: Fetch Page
tools.description: Fetch a web page and return its readable text.

tools.title: Resume Project
tools.description: Rebuild fresh project context, including structured continuation.action, next unfinished task, plan revision, running/recent jobs, uncommitted changes, saved state and next_action, phase checklist, plan progress and next open tasks, docs status, the last 25 journal entries (every command/file/agy run), git log, uncommitted changes and running jobs. Leave slug empty for the most recently active project.

tools.title: Save Checkpoint
tools.description: Save where the project stands (.devpilot/STATE.json) so any later run can resume exactly there. Call after every step. next_action must be concrete.

placeholders.{CHECKPOINT}: save a checkpoint after every step
